medmemo.title: A private health memory assistant that keeps sensitive context on-device.
medmemo.kicker: MedMemo is an open-source desktop application built with Wails, Go, React, layered long-term memory, local AI inference, and privacy safeguards for personal and family health information.
medmemo.caption: Project signal: local-first privacy, long-term memory, multi-model LLM routing, and desktop distribution.
medmemo.scaleBody: Approximate Go and TypeScript project scale from local job materials.
medmemo.memoryBody: Memory layers: working, short-term, and long-term memory.
medmemo.licenseBody: Open-source repository with public GitHub access.
medmemo.takeawayBody: MedMemo demonstrates end-to-end ownership of a difficult AI product surface: desktop delivery, privacy constraints, model routing, local inference, memory retrieval, compliance wording, and user-facing review flows.
medmemo.feature1Body: Core data is designed to stay on the user's device, with SQLCipher/SQLite, local vector retrieval, and on-device AI paths.
medmemo.feature2Body: Conversations become reviewable facts and recallable memory instead of being pushed directly into an LLM context window.
medmemo.feature3Body: OpenAI-compatible providers, local models, and provider health checks are organized behind replaceable interfaces.
medmemo.feature4Body: Wails connects a Go backend with a React/TypeScript interface and cross-platform release concerns.
medmemo.proofIntro: The codebase is organized around Clean Architecture, compile-time dependency injection, local storage, AI adapters, memory use cases, and privacy pipelines.
medmemo.stack1Body: Wails v2, Go, React 18, TypeScript, Zustand, and desktop packaging.
medmemo.stack2Body: Clean Architecture, Google Wire, domain entities, use cases, repositories, and adapters.
medmemo.stack3Body: LLM providers, ONNX Runtime, Hugot, embeddings, sqlite-vec, memory extraction, and confidence handling.
medmemo.safetyBody: MedMemo is a health information management and consultation-assistance tool. It is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis, treatment, prescriptions, or medical decisions.

jobcopilot.title: A multi-service AI platform for resumes, job matching, and application tracking.
jobcopilot.kicker: JobCopilot combines React, Spring Boot, FastAPI, LiteLLM, pgvector, RabbitMQ, Redis, MinIO, and Docker Compose into a practical platform for new graduates and career changers.
jobcopilot.caption: Project signal: semantic matching, asynchronous AI workflows, DDD backend boundaries, and containerized service topology.
jobcopilot.scaleBody: Approximate Java, TypeScript, and Python project scale from local job materials.
jobcopilot.runtimeBody: Main application runtimes: React frontend, Spring Boot backend, and Python AI service.
jobcopilot.vectorBody: Semantic search foundation for resume and job matching.
jobcopilot.licenseBody: Public repository suitable for portfolio review.
jobcopilot.takeawayBody: JobCopilot shows how AI features become product workflows: upload a resume, parse structure, embed content, match jobs, explain recommendations, continue with a chat assistant, and track applications over time.
jobcopilot.feature1Body: Upload, parse, version, edit, download, and optimize resumes through backend workflows and AI service integration.
jobcopilot.feature2Body: PostgreSQL pgvector supports similarity recall, while AI ranking and feedback loops provide a path toward better recommendations.
jobcopilot.feature3Body: RabbitMQ, worker processes, Redis buffers, and MinIO model artifacts separate long-running AI tasks from user-facing APIs.
jobcopilot.feature4Body: Docker Compose isolates frontend, backend, AI, data, cache, queue, and model-registry services behind a frontend gateway.
jobcopilot.proofTitle: Full-stack AI system, not a single demo endpoint.
jobcopilot.proofIntro: The repository uses bounded backend modules, AI service abstractions, frontend routes, message queues, vector storage, and deployment docs as a coherent system.
jobcopilot.stack1Body: React 19, Vite 7, TypeScript, Nginx gateway, i18n, auth flows, resume pages, jobs, chat, tracking, and profile.
jobcopilot.stack2Body: Java 21, Spring Boot 3.5, DDD, hexagonal architecture, Maven modules, REST controllers, and application services.
jobcopilot.stack3Body: Python 3.11, FastAPI, LiteLLM, embeddings, resume/job parsing, LightGBM ranking, RabbitMQ consumers, Redis, and MinIO.
jobcopilot.honestBody: JobCopilot is presented as a public portfolio project with a mature local/container architecture. The current local knowledge base does not claim verified production deployment or broad real-user ranking validation.
